big_case.notes: Pro se, fact-bound municipal employment summary-judgment dispute from an unpublished two-sentence Fifth Circuit Rule 47.6 affirmance, with no circuit split, zero amicus filings, a waived response, and a bare first-conference denial without dissent.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed on 2026-10-31, sixteen days before the 2026-11-16 denial order. Tool call parameters in retrieval_log.json (35 calls, outcome_only capture) show reads of provisioned files and statpack.md, corpus lookup of prior related petition No. 26-80 (denied 2026-10-05) and 2020s priors, and CourtListener opinion searches for Weber v. BNSF Railway and prior Fifth Circuit Scroggins decisions, with no forecast exposure.
